description: Project NOAH (Nationwide Operational Assessment of Hazards) is a data repository run by University of the Philippines, with the Department of Science and Technology. The site carries flood, landslide and storm-surge hazard maps, river-basin flood models, LiDAR-derived terrain products and real-time rainfall and water-level readings produced by the national hazard assessment project. Coverage: Philippines. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as viewer, shp, geotiff; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("NOAH - Nationwide Operational Assessment of Hazards") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support flood and storm-surge exposure studies of Philippine infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
